name: calcite PLACEHOLDER (not a published set)
note: The calcite slab is held rigid (frozen), so only its nonbonded parameters (charge, epsilon, sigma) affect the fluid.
Charges: Ca +2, C +1.123282, O -1.041094. These are recalled from memory as those of Xiao, Edwards & Grater, J. Phys. Chem. C 115 (2011) 20067; check them against the paper.
LJ values: generic CHARMM-like placeholders (CHARMM Ca2+, carbonyl C, carboxylate O). They are NOT the Xiao 2011 values. Use them only for smoke tests.
Before production runs, replace epsilon/sigma (and the charges if needed) with the values in the original paper, then set verified=true.
Option: Raiteri et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 114 (2010) 5997, uses Buckingham terms instead; it needs a hybrid pair_style and is not supported by this template as is.
